title.value: Can Retriever-Augmented Language Models Reason? The Blame Game Between the Retriever and the Language Model
title.justification: The paper aims to explore whether retriever-augmented language models possess strong reasoning capabilities and how different components contribute to their reasoning performance.
title.quote: Augmenting pretrained language models with retrievers has shown promise in effectively solving common NLP problems, such as language modeling and question answering. In this paper, we evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of popular retriever-augmented language models...

extractions.description: This paper investigates the reasoning abilities of retriever-augmented language models across various tasks, such as language modeling and question answering. It evaluates the performance of multiple models like kNN-LM, REALM, and Contriever + Flan-T5, and analyzes the challenges faced by both retrievers and language models in reasoning tasks.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily deals with analyzing and improving the reasoning capabilities of language models and retrievers in NLP tasks like language modeling and question answering. It does not explicitly focus on eco-responsible categories.
primary_category.quote: While the capabilities of parametric language models have been extensively studied in the literature, there is no thorough study of the limitations of non-parametric models...

primary_sub_category.justification: The main focus of the paper is on the strengths and limitations of retriever-augmented language models in reasoning, which does not relate to any specific eco-responsible sub-category.

new_primary_category.justification: The study is focused on technical advancements in NLP through retriever-augmented models and does not address eco-responsible topics.
new_primary_category.quote: Our further analysis indicates that multihop retrieve-and-read is promising for large language models like GPT-3.5, but does not generalize to other language models like Flan-T5-xxl.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no discussion or relevance in the paper to any new eco-responsible sub-category. The focus is on improving language models and retrievers for reasoning tasks.
